rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_unconstrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=25, recon_eta=30.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=0, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, val_n=214, train_n=0, rationale=iter-1 search-20260619-01 UNCONSTRAINED diff-recon vs reused Mayo DDPM v4 ckpt (ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt, ch=96, sees all 10 Wagner patients). CORRECTED metric: val=ALL 214 L277 slices + 321px detector-geometry FOV (default). SOFT DATA-CONSISTENCY ONLY: recon_dcstep_every=0 turns OFF the hard CG projection so data consistency is enforced ONLY by the per-step DPS adaptive-weight gradient (eta=30/||resid||, soft). This is the sole knob distinguishing this from the constrained sibling (which used recon_dcstep_every=5 hard-DC and scored SSIM 0.394 / hr 0 in 1019s). Budget: T=25 DPS steps with NO extra CG iters = strictly fewer proj-equivalents/slice than the constrained run, so it fits the 20-min wall with more headroom (constrained 214 slices ran 17 min). recon_dcstep_n_cg/warmup/relax are INERT here (gated on every>0). HYPOTHESIS: unconstrained soft-DC diffusion-recon lands at/below the ~0.84 LD-FBP floor on real rebinned Mayo, likely near the constrained 0.394 but possibly DIFFERENT because soft DC enforces measurements more weakly than the constrained hard CG projection (weaker fidelity -> prior dominates more, could drift further from anatomy).
